cases.notes: Creating a bookmark must not change the scene head version or snapshot and must persist across reloads.
Generating photoreal for the current snapshot must produce a ready job, persist a gallery entry, and safely replay via idempotency.
Generating photoreal for an older snapshot must add a version-linked gallery entry without rewriting the current editable scene head.
Explicit camera requests, deterministic gallery dedupe, TARGET_NOT_FOUND failures, and IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT paths are independently verified.
